paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -3.04% on average, with FTSE 100 strongest (-1.02%) and Nasdaq weakest (-5.28%). Brent crude changed +0.64% to 92.57. Gold changed -4.62% to 3,515.3999. Bitcoin changed -0.13% to 58,724.6211. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.912%, a relative move of -2.77%. Among the firms tracked, Goldman Sachs (-6.71%) and Freeport-McMoRan (-6.37%) moved the most.
